title: The Manichaean Scriptures (article, AJSL 1920)
author: M. Sprengling
description: M. Sprengling's historical article examines Manichaean scriptures and their study. It provides a focused scholarly entry point into the surviving literature of a religion centred on the conflict between light and darkness.
editionNote: Curator-supplied PDF and EPUB from the organised ebook collection. One format was converted from the other (EPUB from PDF). Source text obtained from the Internet Archive (https://archive.org/details/jstor-528335).
